g.text: Points: actual observations; coincident values overlap. The no-cage reference is repeated in both columns.
Dotted line: source cap = 60 bins. Global bins are not per-voxel admission counts; model states are asynchronous.
Autocorrelated samples; no causal interpretation. *04_loop_A: reported LiDAR/cage relative displacement.
